basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Nurse III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Project Nurse-III post in the ICMR-sponsored PRAGATICAR project, led by Prof./Dr. Suman Chakraborty. The assignment pays consolidated compensation of up to 28000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, for 12 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The essential qualification is a Four-year Nursing Course, the age limit is 35 years, and the last date to apply is 9 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply online for Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/CIH/2026/110 on or before 9 December 2026. The notice does not print the portal address.
Check that your Four-year Nursing Course qualification and your age (35 years limit, counted as on the last date of the advertisement) meet the notice.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

The notice lists the application fee as 0 for every category. It also prints the bank account for fee deposit by RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking: State Bank of India (00202), P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal – 721302; account name IIT SRIC-OM Account; account no. 39502115210; IFSC code SBIN0000202; SWIFT code SBININBB339. The notice names no documents to attach.
important_instructions: The assignment is a temporary one in a purely time-bound research project. The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not guarantee a call for the interview. The fee shown for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST is 0. The notice is a computer-generated document generated by ERP, IIT Kharagpur on 25 November 2026 and requires no signature.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur Project Nurse-III recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Project Nurse-III.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is December 09, 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Nurse-III at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Four-year Nursing Course. B.Sc. Nursing and experience in clinical research, patient recruitment, sample collection, clinical documentation and multicentre validation are listed as desired.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to 28000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice lists the application fee as 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the Project Nurse-III assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. It is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project.

faq.question: Q9. Which project and funding agency is the post under?
faq.answer: The post is under the PRAGATICAR project (Project Code – R/CIH) in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, sponsored by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The PI/Co-PI is Prof./Dr. Suman Chakraborty.

faq.question: Q10. Does meeting the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
